text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're having a meeting to review today's training, when…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Weeell, I wouldn't say that my training has been bad lately, but…
choice_data_list: Is there something on your mind?
Is there something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I feel like I'm right on the verge of a breakthrough, but I can't quite get there…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week's body suddenly goes limp as she says this…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Where… am I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What in the world?! A track?! I don't know what's happening…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And they're into the stretch! It's still Special Week in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How is this possible?! I'm almost at the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Will Special Week be able to display her prowess all the way to the finish with her rivals pursuing her?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Geez! If you say stuff like that, I'm gonna have to keep running!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the winner is Special Week! She gets the job done, and the crowd can go home happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wonder what race that was…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I don't really get what's going on, but that was fun.The feeling of having the finish line in sight… Oh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's it! I finally know the answer to what's been bugging me for so long!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooosh…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa, everything's gone back to normal!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Anyway, just listen to me! I had an epiphany!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I finally figured out when I should make my last spurt to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I don't know how it happened. Maybe it's just because it's been bothering me for so long…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But I feel like my training is gonna go better than ever from now on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The epiphany seems to have unlocked some of the potential hidden inside of Special Week.
